name: 浣纱录
overview: After modern-day medical Ph.D. Li Yunhe is transported into the body of the Zhou family's live-in son-in-law, he becomes the family's only hope of reviving the famed Xiangyunsha silk. Battling his rival Lu Qifeng and later aiding Emperor Zhao Yunzhuo in defeating Prince Ning's rebellion, Li Yunhe rises from an overlooked outsider to a legendary figure.
